purpose: Remove the closed-file unresolved-require refresh stat storm on the official two-project warm complete index. Do not skip project-file body inference.

cut.why: CPU-weighted samply on the official two-project warm run put Path::is_file → stat at 5.9s exclusive. reresolve was 6.9s CPU / 3.08s+3.19s overlapping wall, walking ~300 gem roots per stored require.
changes: Closed-file refresh reuses stored diagnostic messages (no Prism reparse).
Publish builds RequireFeatureIndex from engine-registered .rb paths, first published root wins.
Snapshot paths once, sort, prefix-range scan. Do not files()×roots or readdir gem trees at publish.
require still stats project loadPaths / lib / root first. require_relative stays dirname-only.
Goto, hover, collection, and refresh share the same resolve_require_path.
not_done: Do not restore per-require Path::is_file across dependency roots.
Do not walk gem trees at publish when the engine already has those files (1.6s intermediate).
Do not skip TypeTracker / higher-order / local flow / inferred returns on project files.

before.notes: Skip-Prism closed-file refresh already in the tree; parse was not the tail.

two_project_warm_repeat.notes: Refresh and index stay ~15ms / ~44ms. Complete wall moved with gem-bind overlap, not require lookup.

result.rss_notes: Peak RSS 1.52–1.83 GB across repeats; the feature map is not a material RSS owner.

example_identity_note: Published workspace, symbol, and fixture identities are generic historical labels. Measurements are unchanged; retired fixture labels do not refer to the current synthetic regression.
